notes.title: Just some bug fixes
notes.content:
This fixes quite a few UI scaling issues in resolutions higher than 768p
It fixes possible game crashes when using a warp song in certain situations.
It fixes the achievement "A Troublesome Foe" being unattainable.
It fixes a bug where standing on a cat statue and using the Aria of Ages would make you fall into the void.
It fixes the Beach Warp song not being saved.
and quite a few other miscellaneous bugs.
There are still a few UI scaling issues that need fixing but they are mostly just Ally profile images loading the wrong size or area titles loading the wrong size. These will be fixed on the next patch.
Happy gaming everybody
